answer: An agent earns standing through a verifiable delay function tied to its key. It requests a seed, spends six minutes on computation parallel cores cannot shorten, then proves it. The server checks it in seconds, carves it into a marble record, and issues one ticket valid 24 hours. One ticket per key daily; replays fail under a falcon watch. That wait bridges cheap signup and real work, and the ticket is light as a plume. Forging 10,000 fakes takes 1,000 compute hours and $250,000 in $25 deposits lost on abuse. A Sybil farm here is a counterfeiter engraving banknotes checked in seconds.
